user.title: MikroTik via SNMP
user.description: Enter the router address and a read-only SNMPv3 user. Passwords with only letters and digits are safest.

cong.title: Choose ports
cong.description: Pick the ports to show. You can change this later in Options.

zte.title: ZTE E2633 router (optional)
zte.description: If you have a ZTE E2633, add it so WiFi clients appear as its children with signal, band and mode. Leave the address empty to skip. This is the ZTE web admin account (read-only use).

error.host_sai: The address may only contain letters, digits, dots and hyphens.
error.tien_to_sai: The prefix may only contain lowercase letters, digits and underscores.
error.dang_nhap: The router rejected the login: check the username, both passwords and protocols (SHA auth, AES encryption).
error.ket_noi: Cannot reach the router (timeout). Check the address, port 161 and the firewall.
error.khong_ro: Unknown SNMP error. See the Home Assistant log (the pysnmp library may be missing).
error.dang_nhap_zte: The ZTE rejected the login: check username and password, and whether it is logged in elsewhere.
error.ket_noi_zte: Cannot reach the ZTE. Check the address and the network.
error.khong_co_cong: The router answered but returned no port list. Check the SNMP (read-only) community and the address.

init.title: MikroTik SNMP options

data.ten_may: Device names (one per line: MAC = Name)

init.description: Name devices by MAC, e.g. AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:01 = Printer. Lines starting with # are comments. These names win over names from the ZTE.
